blocking_facts: Current build_expert_mix has no retained gate-output input before branch construction.
One-stream dataflow already showed gate helper D2H/CPU scatter instead of retained GPU output.
The final hot/cold combine copy lower bound consumes 17.197 ms of the 18.947 ms graph margin at 24 GiB/s.
candidate_routes.name: split graph with gate_all reused by hot and cold branches
candidate_routes.required_change: Compute selected gate once, keep gate_all on CUDA, route cold up/down through original tensors and hot up/down through compact top64 resident tensors.

blocking_facts: Without retained gate input this either recomputes gate, which has a 9.861 tok/s hard bound, or needs a multi-output/side-channel graph change.
Returning hot contribution still requires a hot/cold combine with essentially no remaining margin.
candidate_routes.name: new fused sparse op returning only hot contribution
candidate_routes.required_change: Single CUDA op consumes cur_ffn, selected IDs, weights, and compact top64 up/down payload, then returns hot contribution for add with cold contribution.

blocking_facts: Current DS4_HOT shape is rectangular K+P+1 per active layer, inflating 64 real pairs to 295 retained entries.
Payload inflates to 2507.5 MiB up/down or 3761.25 MiB gate/up/down, far above the ideal 544 MiB route and above the graph margin via gate-cache pressure.
candidate_routes.name: adapt current DS4_HOT_DISPATCH to sparse top64 profile
candidate_routes.required_change: Use existing hot manager remap tables and dual dispatch with sparse profile.

blocking_facts: Cold expert weights are mostly CPU_Mapped/CUDA_Host in the accepted path; including cold path in the fused op reintroduces the full fallback/source problem.
This becomes a new full MoE CUDA implementation, not the bounded top64 sparse retained route, and has no measured correctness/performance bound yet.
candidate_routes.name: single fused op replacing both hot and cold MoE output
candidate_routes.required_change: One op computes full selected MoE output and writes final n_embd result on CUDA, eliminating explicit hot/cold combine.

decision: Close the current sparse retained top64 route for now. The only theoretical positive bound depends on a retained CUDA gate tensor and near-zero combine overhead, but the pushed-source probe shows neither is present in the accepted graph. No logit-changing source edit is allowed from this route without a new probe that first proves retained gate placement and a combine-copy budget with meaningful margin.
next_plan: Do not adapt DS4_HOT_DISPATCH or add a sparse hot write path on the current graph.
Start a fresh bottleneck search from the accepted 4.4 tok/s SOTA or design a new full-MoE CUDA route with its own hard bound.

If revisiting sparse retained later, the first proof must be a placement probe showing gate_all retained on CUDA and final combine copy under the remaining margin before correctness or performance benchmarking.
